title: Aney Synodeias
description:
This project began to be made at the bus station of Ano Liosia in the spring of 2023, when me and Nikiforos were waiting for a lost bus to Larissa and he remembered to bring his "notebook" with his poems. Then I read them and listened to them at the same time, as they had a very clear musicality. The following year they were published by Iolkos Publications and, since then, for the next two years, I set to music, orchestrated and built something that would take shape in October 2026, unexpectedly, as the production I had made was very complex and exuberant, surpassing our financial and practical budgets. It was something I'd never done before. In this journey, with Nikiforos and all the contributors as companions, this dream came true and I am happy and blessed that I learned so much and connected with all these people who contributed, visible and invisible.

This work is made with MUCH love by MANY beautiful people.

Enjoy irresponsibly.
